title: Density of torus Fourier characters in $L^p$
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite index set, let $\mu$ be a finite measure on the torus with coordinates indexed by $\iota$, and let $p$ be a finite real exponent with $1\le p$. The complex linear span of all torus Fourier characters is dense in $L^p(\mu;\mathbb C)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ is a finite measure on the torus indexed by $\iota$
